# RentFriends

> RentFriends is a Polish mobile app and platform for finding flatmates, rooms and flats, and for managing shared-flat life. It matches people by lifestyle, budget and habits, and helps landlords find suitable tenants. Free to use, currently launching in Wrocław, Poland.

RentFriends has two parts: Matcher, for finding flatmates and places to live, and Manager, for running a shared flat (cleaning schedules, task assignment, reminders).

## Apps

- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.dyzury)
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/gr/app/rentfriends-rent-rooms/id6502833411)

## Optional

- [Add a listing](https://ogloszenia.rentfriends.app/): form for landlords to publish a room or flat listing free of charge.
- Contact: kontakt@rentfriends.app
